message.content: LiHua mentions a local music festival as an opportunity for the Jolly Band to perform in front of an audience. This festival seems to be an ideal chance for the band to showcase their talents and engage with fans, given the context of their discussion about preparing for the event. Specifically, LiHua suggests, "Did you see the poster saying that our town is holding a local music festival? It looks like it can be an opportunity for our band to perform in front of the crowd!" This indicates that the local music festival is seen as a significant platform for the Jolly Band to gain exposure and possibly earn some recognition.
